B1-beauty_salon_forms.d:
Professional paperwork for lash artists, brow techs and estheticians, all in one beautiful matching set. 20 forms plus 2 Excel trackers, ready to fill on screen or print.

WHY THIS PACK IS DIFFERENT
• 4 consent templates (lash extensions, brow lamination & lash lift, facial, waxing) with a health check and initial-each-line acknowledgments
• Lash mapping sheet, patch test record and client service record so every visit is consistent
• Printable cards: appointment, aftercare (write your own), feedback and gift certificates
• Excel: sales, tips & commission tracker plus a client rebooking tracker that flags overdue clients
• Fillable PDFs AND editable Word files, in US Letter and A4, with a logo slot

• B-01 New Client Intake Form
• B-02 Consultation & Treatment Plan
• B-03 Lash Extension Consent Form
• B-04 Brow Lamination & Lash Lift Consent
• B-05 Facial Treatment Consent Form

• B-15 Daily Appointment Book
• B-16 Sanitation & Cleaning Log
• B-17 Product & Retail Inventory
• B-18 Client Feedback Cards
• B-19 Photo & Social Media Release
• B-20 Daily Sales & Tips Log

EXCEL TRACKERS
• Sales, tips & commission: totals, commission and technician take-home
• Client database & rebooking: next-due date fills in and overdue clients turn red

GREAT FOR
Lash artists, brow artists, estheticians, waxing studios, med-spa front desks, beauty students opening their first studio and salon suite renters.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the ZIP and unzip it (right-click > Extract All on Windows, double-click on Mac).
2. Open 00_START_HERE.pdf.
3. Type into the fillable PDFs in free Adobe Acrobat Reader, or edit the Word files to add your logo and change any wording.
4. Print as many copies as you need.

FILE FORMATS
• Fillable PDF (US Letter + A4)
• Editable Word .docx (US Letter + A4): Microsoft Word, Google Docs, Pages, LibreOffice
• Excel .xlsx calculators: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
